description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange from 29.07.2019 to 04.08.2019
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette. The content involves statutory instruments and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
